sections.heading: Scope & intent
bullets: Does the change match the ticket or PR description?
Is the diff minimal for the problem being solved?
Are unrelated refactors split out or called out clearly?

sections.heading: Correctness
bullets: Edge cases and error paths are handled or explicitly deferred.
Types and invariants match runtime behavior.
Concurrency, ordering, and idempotency are considered where relevant.

sections.heading: Security & privacy
bullets: Inputs are validated; secrets never logged or committed.
AuthZ checks apply to new endpoints or UI surfaces.
Dependencies and transitive risk are acceptable for the change.

sections.heading: Tests & observability
bullets: Critical paths have coverage or a clear reason they do not.
Logs and metrics help diagnose failures in production.
Rollout, feature flags, or migrations are safe to operate.

sections.heading: Review tone
bullets: Prefer questions and suggestions over demands.
Acknowledge what works well—it speeds up the next iteration.
